content: Ligand 1 is interesting as a reminder rather than a lead: it carries a 4,6-dimethylpyrimidin-2-ylamino, and its jnk3 is exactly zero - consistent with my measurement that substituting the azine position adjacent to the ring nitrogen is fatal, and with that amine being attached to an sp3 carbon rather than conjugated to a ring. Atom 0 is one of its ring methyls over an acyclic bond, so it is a clean anchor. Last blind episode of the generation, and it closes the linker series. Having tried sulfonyl, reversal and urea, this one is the smallest possible perturbation: keep the anilide exactly as it is and change the carbonyl oxygen to sulfur. A thioamide has the same shape and the same donor, a weaker acceptor, a more acidic N-H and a notably more lipophilic character. Combined with the other three it separates geometry from the specific atom - if the sulfonyl and reversal both fail but the thioamide holds, the requirement is a planar amide in that orientation rather than an oxygen in particular. Surviving methyl becomes the pyridine 4-methyl. Expected product: about 297 Da.
